description: Compute GB per minute for each scan, then average those ratios within each health/safety status.

c.request: For scans matched to their site (skip any whose site code isn't in `sites`), break things down by the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`). For each status, show the total number of scans (`scancount`) and the GB per minute of scanning, based on `gbsize` and `spanmin`, ignoring missing values. Only include statuses whose GB per minute is strictly above the average of that figure across statuses (none if that average is missing). Show the status, the total scans, the GB per minute, and how much it exceeds that average. No rounding. Compute GB per minute for each scan, then average those ratios within each health/safety status.
c.sql:
WITH per_scan AS (
  SELECT st.healtheval AS health_status,
         sc.scancount,
         sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) AS gb_per_min
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE st.healtheval IS NOT NULL
),
by_status AS (
  SELECT health_status,
         SUM(scancount) AS total_scans,
         AVG(gb_per_min) AS gb_per_min
  FROM per_scan
  GROUP BY health_status
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM by_status
)
SELECT b.health_status,
       b.total_scans,
       b.gb_per_min,
       b.gb_per_min - o.avg_gb_per_min AS exceeds_avg_by
FROM by_status b
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE b.gb_per_min > o.avg_gb_per_min;

a.request: Match each scan in `scans` to its site in `sites` on site code (`zoneref` = `zoneregistry`), leaving out scans whose site code isn't found. Group by the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`). For each status, compute the total of `scancount` and a GB-per-minute rate obtained by first dividing each scan's own `gbsize` by its own `spanmin` and then taking the mean of those per-scan ratios. Missing values are ignored in sums and averages. Compute the average of that rate across all statuses and keep only the statuses whose rate is strictly above it (none if that average is missing). List the status, the total scan count, the rate, and the rate minus that average. No rounding.
a.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize::double precision / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM per_status) SELECT p.status, p.total_scans, p.rate, p.rate - a.avg_rate AS rate_diff FROM per_status p CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE p.rate > a.avg_rate;

b.request: Per-scan GB/min = gbsize / spanmin (skipping rows where gbsize or spanmin is NULL, and rows whose scans.zoneref has no match in sites); average those ratios within each sites.healtheval group; report each group's total scancount (SUM, ignoring NULLs) and average GB/min, keeping only groups whose average is strictly greater than the mean of the group averages (no groups if that mean is NULL), with the excess over that mean unrounded
b.sql:
WITH per_scan AS (
  SELECT st.healtheval,
         s.scancount,
         s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS gb_per_min
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
),
grp AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         SUM(scancount) AS total_scancount,
         AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM per_scan
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
mean_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS m FROM grp
)
SELECT g.healtheval,
       g.total_scancount,
       g.avg_gb_per_min,
       g.avg_gb_per_min - m.m AS excess_over_mean
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN mean_avg m
WHERE g.avg_gb_per_min > m.m;

d.request: Compute GB per minute for each scan, then average those per-scan ratios within each health/safety status (`healtheval`), skipping scans whose site code isn't in `sites` and ignoring missing values.
d.sql: SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 AND s.healtheval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.healtheval;
